plan-reread-before-resuming.principle: Re-read active plan and shared planning files before resuming after a gap and before major decisions.

explicit-retry-bounds.principle: Define explicit stop conditions and retry bounds for recovery work instead of open-ended retries.

match-observation-mode.principle: Choose the browser observation mode that matches the task instead of defaulting to one capture style.

shell-safe-browser-eval.principle: Use shell-safe input methods for complex browser eval commands instead of brittle nested quoting.

reuse-auth-state.principle: Prefer reusing authenticated browser sessions over repeating login flows.

source-backed-claims.principle: Cite source URLs for externally researched claims and label tentative ones explicitly.

source-hierarchy.principle: Prefer highest-authority sources first for research; use secondary sources as supporting context only.

live-schema-confirmation.principle: Inspect live tool schemas before assuming argument shapes for CLI-backed tools.

fallback-and-failure-classification.principle: Try documented fallback paths before escalating; classify failure type before redesigning.
